2.4.1.3-f2.text: Satyrium & eruca penem erigunt, vitex & nymphea semen extinguunt

translations.note: Satyrium is an orchid thought to be an aphrodisiac; Burton's sidenote calls it "Priest pintle". Eruca is rocket. Vitex is the chaste tree (agnus castus), and nymphaea is the water lily. In his English that follows, Burton tones the first clause down to "provoke lust".
